ranking_methodology.dynasty: 65% FantasyCalc dynasty value + 20% age-adjusted value + 15% recent 8-week PPG (position-normalized). Youth bonus (+3) for age<=23 with FC value > 50.
ranking_methodology.winnow: 55% FantasyCalc redraft value + 25% last-8-week PPG + 10% offensive snap share + 10% target share (position-normalized).
